QUESTION 1:
```{r}

Rast802 <- terra::rast("./erie_raster_ex/images/ts_2017.0802_0808.L4.LE3.CIcyano.MAXIMUM_7day.tif")

Bound <- st_read("./erie_raster_ex/bounds/bb_erie_large.shp")

plot(Rast802)


tm_shape(Rast802) + tm_raster() + tm_shape(Bound) + tm_polygons()

print(cellSize(Rast802)

      
      
      
      
      
CalcCyanoSize <- function(Raster){
  
  FilteredRast <- Raster %>% 
    freq() %>% 
    filter(value <= 249) %>% 
    filter(value > 1)
    
  Size <- FilteredRast %>% 
    sum(.$count) * 90000
  
  print(Size)
}

CalcCyanoSize(Rast802)




```
